 -3-  NC: 2023:KHC-D:13238  MFA No. 104092 of 2019  JUDGMENT
This appeal is filed by the claimant challenging the judgment and award dated 16.04.2016 passed by the tribunal, in MVC.No.1196/2015 seeking enhancement of compensation.

2. Heard the arguments and perused the material placed before the Court.
3.
The occurrence of accident, injuries sustained by the claimant, coverage of insurance are not in dispute in this case.
4. In the present case, from the medical evidence on record it is proved that the claimant had suffered the following injuries.

"1. Abrasion over left shoulder lat part 4 x 5 cms 2. Tender + left clavicle"
5.

The tribunal has awarded compensation under various heads as under:
NC: 2023:KHC-D:13238 Sl. Heads. Amount in No. (Rs.)
1. Pain and sufferings 30,000/-
2. Loss of amenities & happiness 25,000/-
3. Medical & incidental charges 10,000/-
4. Loss of earnings during 10,000/-
treatment period 5. Loss of future earnings due to 1,51,200/-

3
disability
Considering the nature of injuries sustained, compensation awarded by tribunal is lesser side.
Therefore, the same is required to be enhanced by modifying the judgment and award.

7. Considering the injuries sustained, a compensation of Rs.40,000/- towards pain and suffering,
Rs.30,000/- towards loss of amenities are awarded.
The compensation awarded towards medical expenses and hospital charges of Rs.10,000/- is as per the actual bills and receipts produced

;
therefore, the same is kept intact.

Further, Rs.5,000/- towards incidental expenses like food, NC:
2023:KHC-D:13238 nourishment, traveling, attendant charges, etc., and Rs.16,000/- (Rs.8,000/-
pm., x 2 months) towards loss of income during laid up period for a period of two months, is awarded.
8. The doctor has stated that the claimant had suffered 20% of physical disability to the whole body.
Therefore, considering the evidence of the doctor, 20% functional disability is taken into consideration.

Accordingly as per the age group mentioned in National Insurance Company Limited vs. Pranay Sethi and others, reported in (2017) 16 Supreme Court Cases 680, and as per the Division Bench judgment of this Court in New India Assurance Company Vs. Abdul S/o Mehaboob Tahasildar in MFA No.103807/2016 C/w. MFA Nos.103835/2016 & 103807/2018 and as per the judgment of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Sidram vs. Divisional Manager, United India Insurance Company Limited and another reported in (2023) 3 SCC NC: 2023:KHC-D:13238 439, even in the case of injuries, certain income is to be added towards loss of future prospects in life.

sentences.text: 9. The accident is caused in the year 22.10.2015.
Therefore, notional income of Rs.8,000/- per month is taken into consideration, which is recognized by the Karnataka State Legal Service Authority.
The claimant was aged 41 years at the time of accident.
Therefore appropriate applicable multiplier is 14.

Hence, loss of future income due to disability is hereby reassessed and quantified as Rs.2,68,800/- (Rs.8,000/- x 20% x 12 x 14).
10.

Thus, the claimant is entitled for total compensation under various heads as under:
 Sl. Heads. Amount in  No. (Rs.)
 1. Pain and sufferings 40,000/-
 2. Loss of amenities & happiness 30,000/-
 3. Medical & incidental charges 10,000/-
 4. Incidental expenses such food, 5,000/-
 nourishment, traveling,

4  attendant charges etc.,
 4. Loss of earnings during 16,000/-
 treatment period  5. Loss of future earnings due to 2,68,800/-

Therefore, the claimant is entitled for total compensation of Rs.3,69,800/- along with interest at the rate of 6% p.a. from the date of filing of the petition till realization, as against Rs.2,26,200/-
awarded by the Tribunal.
Respondent Nos.2 and 3 are directed to deposit the compensation within eight weeks from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this judgment.

12. In the result, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER i) The appeal is allowed in part.
ii) The judgment and award dated 16.04.2016 passed by the tribunal, in MVC.No.1196/2015 stands modified.
NC: 2023:KHC-D:13238 iii) The claimant is entitled for total compensation of Rs.3,69,800/- along with interest at the rate of 6% p.a. from the date of petition till its realization.
iv) The claimant is not entitled for interest for the delayed period of 1119 days in filing the appeal.
v) Respondent Nos.2 and 3 shall deposit the amount within a period of eight weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment.
vi) Send back the trial Court records along with a copy of this judgment.
vii) No order as to costs.
viii) Draw award accordingly.

sentences.text: The appeal is disposed off on 10.11.2023 by enhancing the quantum of compensation.
In the operative portion of the order in page No.8 in clause No.iv it is ordered both respondent Nos.2 and 3 shall deposit the amount.
Since the insurance coverage is not disputed, therefore, it ought to have been ordered both respondent Nos.2 and 3 are jointly and severally liable to pay compensation.
Therefore, respondent No.3 shall pay compensation to the claimant.
Accordingly, it is clarified.
The copy of this order of 'being spoken to' shall be appended to the main order as a part and partial of the order.

SD/-
